name: Sky Hook Feather Token
body:
Price 200 gp

DESCRIPTION

This token transforms into a huge disembodied eagle’s talon (hardness 5, hp 25) anchored wherever you activate it. The talon can support up to 1,000 pounds and persists for 1 day. The talon can be moved up to 10 feet with a DC 20 Strength check.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, major creation; Cost 100 gp
